description: This source file is a JavaScript module responsible for processing and rendering release notes for the Playwright project. It parses markdown files containing release notes, adjusts heading levels, extracts relevant sections based on version, and generates output with appropriate links tailored to different programming languages.

methods.name: parseApi
methods.description: Parses API documentation from specified directory paths.

methods.name: visitAll
methods.description: Traverses all nodes in the markdown AST, applying a callback to each node.

methods.name: renderPlaywrightDevLinks
methods.description: Renders the markdown content with development links tailored for Playwright.

methods.name: docsLinkRendererForLanguage
methods.description: Provides a URL renderer function for documentation links based on language.

methods.name: languageToRelativeDocsPath
methods.description: Converts language identifiers to paths for documentation links.
